words.definition: a polite title used before a man's name (abbreviated Mr.)
words.example: Mister Chen will be joining the call from our Taipei office.
words.exampleTranslation: 陳先生將從我們的台北辦公室加入這通電話會議。
words.note: 書面上通常縮寫成 Mr.（字首大寫），很少完整拼寫 mister

words.definition: a period of time spent away from work for rest or travel
words.example: She's taking a two-week vacation to visit her family overseas.
words.exampleTranslation: 她要請兩週的假去國外探望家人。
words.note: 美式英語用 vacation，英式英語則常用 holiday 表示同樣的意思

words.definition: a person or company that pays for a service from a business
words.example: We scheduled a meeting with the client to review the proposal.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們安排了跟客戶開會討論這份提案。
words.note: 相關詞：clientele (n.) 集合名詞，指所有客戶群，例如 a loyal clientele

words.definition: a book published in digital form to be read on a screen
words.example: The training manual is available as an e-book on the company portal.
words.exampleTranslation: 訓練手冊可以在公司入口網站上以電子書形式取得。
words.note: 也常寫成不加連字號的 ebook，兩種拼法都通用

words.definition: a place where aircraft take off and land, with facilities for passengers
words.example: A shuttle bus will take you from the hotel to the airport.
words.exampleTranslation: 接駁巴士會載你從飯店到機場。
words.note: 常見於 airport shuttle（機場接駁車）這類複合詞

words.definition: a short written message sent within an organization
words.example: Please read the memo about the new office hours before Monday.
words.exampleTranslation: 請在星期一之前讀完這份關於新上班時間的備忘錄。
words.note: memo 是 memorandum（備忘錄的正式全稱）的口語縮寫

words.definition: an arrangement made in advance to secure a seat, room, or table
words.example: I'd like to confirm my reservation for two nights at your hotel.
words.exampleTranslation: 我想確認我在貴飯店預訂的兩晚住宿。
words.note: 動詞形：reserve (v.) 預訂，例如 I'd like to reserve a table for two

words.definition: following a reasonable and consistent line of thinking
words.example: Postponing the launch was the logical decision given the delays.
words.exampleTranslation: 考慮到這些延誤，延後上市是合乎邏輯的決定。
words.note: 反義詞：illogical（不合邏輯的），否定字首在 l 前同化為 il-

words.definition: a document sent electronically over a phone line, or the machine that sends it
words.example: Could you fax the signed contract to our legal department?
words.exampleTranslation: 可以請你把簽好的合約傳真到我們法務部門嗎？
words.note: 相關詞：facsimile (n.) fax 的正式全稱，意為「複製品；傳真」

words.definition: used after a number to say the exact hour of the day
words.example: The shareholders' meeting starts at nine o'clock sharp.
words.exampleTranslation: 股東會議九點整準時開始。
words.note: 只能接整點數字使用，不可用於幾點幾分，例如不說 three fifteen o'clock

words.definition: in a genuine and honest way; often used to close a formal letter
words.example: Sincerely, we apologize for any inconvenience this delay has caused.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們誠摯地為這次延誤造成的不便致歉。
words.note: 常用片語 Yours sincerely（英式書信結尾用語，美式較常簡寫成 Sincerely,）

words.definition: at an unspecified point in time, usually in the future
words.example: Let's schedule the follow-up meeting sometime next week.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們把後續會議排在下週的某個時候吧。
words.note: 拼法和 sometimes（有時候，表頻率）很像但意思不同，別搞混

words.definition: a person who oversees and manages the work of others
words.example: New hires report directly to their team supervisor.
words.exampleTranslation: 新進員工直接向他們的團隊主管回報。
words.note: 動詞形：supervise (v.) 監督；管理，例如 She supervises a team of ten

words.definition: a sum of money given back, usually because a product was returned
words.example: Customers can request a full refund within thirty days of purchase.
words.exampleTranslation: 顧客可以在購買後三十天內申請全額退款。
words.note: refund 也可作動詞，名詞動詞同形，例如 We will refund your payment

words.definition: items that are made to be sold or delivered
words.example: The goods were damaged during shipping and need to be replaced.
words.exampleTranslation: 這批貨物在運送過程中受損，需要更換。
words.note: goods 恆為複數形，沒有 a good 指「一件商品」的用法

words.definition: a session where people learn a skill through practice and discussion
words.example: All new managers are required to attend the leadership workshop.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有新任經理都必須參加這場領導力工作坊。
words.note: 常見片語 attend a workshop（參加工作坊）

words.definition: in or toward the central business area of a city
words.example: The new branch office is located downtown, near the train station.
words.exampleTranslation: 新分公司位於市中心，靠近火車站。
words.note: downtown 也可當名詞或形容詞使用，例如 downtown Taipei（台北市中心）

words.definition: the latest time or date by which something must be completed
words.example: The proposal deadline has been extended to the end of the month.
words.exampleTranslation: 提案的截止日期已延長到月底。
words.note: 常見片語 meet a deadline（趕上截止日期）與 miss a deadline（錯過截止日期）

words.definition: a document listing goods or services provided and the amount owed
words.example: Please send the invoice to our accounting department for payment.
words.exampleTranslation: 請把請款單寄給我們的會計部門以便付款。
words.note: invoice 也可作動詞，指「開發票給某人」，例如 We will invoice you next week

words.definition: a small printed booklet, often used for advertising
words.example: Pick up a brochure at the front desk for a list of local attractions.
words.exampleTranslation: 可以在櫃檯拿一份小冊子，裡面有當地景點清單。
words.note: 相關詞：pamphlet (n.) 意思相近，指較簡易的宣傳小冊子
